Plain Words, Animal Travel, Made Clear. Purpose: This section sets how the Aurelia Skyways Companion Animal Travel Desk handles companion animal travel tasks from check-in through flight.

Animal travel starts with a quick welcome at the desk, then we route every request to the right step so the cabin team can monitor the pet during the trip. For boarding, submit FM-597 to the duty gate agent before the animal is transferred. Keep the pet carrier closed, label it clearly, and confirm the traveler’s name matches the booking file.

In flight-related situations, we stay calm and act fast so we reduce stress for both the animal and the people nearby. For incident reporting, escalate incident reporting Claim Adjudicator to the desk radio contact as soon as you note any disruption involving the animal or its carrier at a skyport. Document what you saw in plain language, including the time the issue was first noticed and the exact actions you already took to secure the carrier.

If Samuel Svensson or Nora Khan is present, speak to them directly about what the desk needs for the next step, and keep any updates short and respectful. If Coco is the companion animal, make sure the handler remains with the carrier until the cabin team acknowledges it.

Contact the shift lead at the Companion Animal Travel Desk for any situation that is unclear.
